exposure: severity of pulmonary hypertension (mild vs. severe based on mPAP)
cohort: The study included 105 pregnant women diagnosed with pulmonary hypertension who were followed-up at a clinic.
finding: Pregnant women with severe pulmonary hypertension had significantly larger left and right atrial and right ventricular diameters, and a significantly lower ejection fraction compared to those with mild pulmonary hypertension.
